answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the whisper seed, the violet timing is verifiable from the nebula record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 265 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 95 keys hence pays 95 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
